english.title: Aid / abet the use of a motor vehicle without insurance
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) aided, abetted, counselled or procured **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a road, or other public place, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD OR PUBLIC PLACE AND LOCATION..) when there was not in force in relation to that use such a policy of insurance complying with the requirements of Part VI of the Road Traffic Act 1988
english.legislation: Contrary to section 143(2) of the Road Traffic Act 1988, section 44 of the Magistrates' Courts Act 1980 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
aided/abetted/counselled/procured use motor vehicle on a road/public place
not in force in relation to that use policy of insurance

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Until 1st November 2021, securities or deposits could be used as an alternative to conventional motor insurance. For the offence applying before the 1st November 2021, see H373.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) **(..SPECIFY PRINCIPAL OFFENDER..) used **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) on **(..SPECIFY ROAD OR PUBLIC PLACE AND LOCATION..) when there was no insurance in force covering that use of the vehicle.

The defendant aided and abetted the use of the vehicle by **(..SPECIFY PRINCIPAL OFFENDER..) in that **(..SPECIFY PARTICULARS..).
